# Multitenant Billing

Version 0.0.0 · Owners: [@benallfree](https://github.com/benallfree)

Billing for [tenants](/docs/extensions/tenants), independent of any payment provider: plans and their quotas, the
provider hook that adapters implement (checkout links, webhooks, renewals, cancellations, refunds), applying a
subscription's plan to an account, and a reconcile job that compares accounts with the provider.

**Runs on:** [tenants](/docs/extensions/tenants) (level 4). Providers are separate extensions, e.g.
[tenant-billing-ls](/docs/extensions/tenant-billing-ls) for Lemon Squeezy.

> **Build it.** Nothing is published here yet. PocketHost's own billing (in its legacy Node mothership) is split
> between this extension and the Lemon Squeezy adapter. See [Create your own extension](/docs/writing-an-extension).

[Install](#install) · [Configure](#configure) · [Use](#use) · [Integrations](#integrations) · [Example](#example)

## Install

Not available yet: Multitenant Billing isn't in `pocketone` and has no Go module to add to a custom build.

## Configure

Nothing to configure yet. Plans and their quotas will be set here when it ships.

## Use

Nothing to use yet. It is planned to apply each subscription's plan to its account and to check accounts against the payment provider on a schedule.

## Integrations

It is planned to run on [tenants](/docs/extensions/tenants). Payment providers plug in through its provider hook as separate extensions; [tenant-billing-ls](/docs/extensions/tenant-billing-ls) is the Lemon Squeezy one.

## Example

No example yet; it will come with the extension.
